title: Cebu Capitol suspends P20 terminal fees at north, south bus terminals
summary: by: Lyle Andales CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government on Wednesday, October 21, approved the temporary suspension of the P20 terminal fees at the Cebu North and South Bus Terminals…

blocks.text: by: Lyle Andales CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government on Wednesday, October 21, approved the temporary suspension of the P20 terminal fees at the Cebu North and South Bus Terminals to ease the burden on the transport sector amid rising fuel prices and operating costs.
